Images are served from the developer's own WordPress backend at api.imandevelopers.com. The small amenity PNGs under /uploads/2025/04/ and /2025/05/ (Rooftop-Gym.png etc.) were measured at around 90x68 and are pictogram icons, so they are excluded. I downloaded and LOOKED at every image listed here. BIG FILENAME WARNING: the folder-style prefix 'exterior-' is wrong on three of the five - exterior-2-2 is an aerial of podium sports courts, exterior-4-2 is an INDOOR planted garden lounge, exterior-5-2 is a rooftop pool at night. Only exterior-1-2 is a building exterior. SECOND WARNING: one-park-central-2.jpg, the file named after the project, is not a render at all - it is a photograph of the live construction site with tower cranes and IMAN hoarding. No floor plans are published as images on this page.
